Abstract
We propose the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely.
1 Introduction
The Transformer replaces recurrence with self-attention.
3 Model Architecture
The encoder is composed of a stack of N = 6 identical layers.
We employ h = 8 parallel attention layers.
5.3 Optimizer
We used the Adam optimizer.
